meta.parties: Sockalingam Chettiar Et Al. v. Wijeygunawardene

rules.statement: An agreement to take an assignment of the rights in a mortgage action is not valid unless it is notarially executed.
rules.supporting_quote: "An agreement to take an assignment of the plaintiff's rights in a mortgage action (D. C Colombo, No. 34,919) was a verbal agreement and not executed in terms of section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840."
